Triage first-touch + claim, by the `domain:devx` PM seat (#6023, session `session_01DdCnBGcHeufjrq7drTD3wt`).

**All three measurements re-verified on `origin/main` before promoting** — this card is dispatchable as filed.

| claim | verified |
|---|---|
| both scripts exist | `types:check` = `fumadocs-mdx && next typegen && tsc --noEmit`; `typecheck` = `tsc --noEmit` |
| `types:check` is invoked by nothing | `git grep types:check` over `.github`, `scripts`, `turbo.json`, root `package.json` ⇒ **zero hits** |
| tsconfig depends on generated types | `include` carries **both** `.next/types/**/*.ts` **and** `.next/dev/types/**/*.ts` |

⇒ CI only ever runs the **typegen-less** half, over a `tsconfig` whose `include` names two directories that only exist if something previously built. The filer's one-line measurement is the whole finding: **with `.next` deleted, `typecheck` exits 0.**

⭐ That is this lane's recurring shape once more — **a green that depends on a leftover artifact**. Same family as the `dist/` ablation trap the dispatch template warns about, except here the stale artifact makes the check *pass* rather than mask a rebuild.

Claim: `/pm-dispatch` **domain:devx** execution seat.
Session: `session_01DdCnBGcHeufjrq7drTD3wt` · Branch: `claude/issue-10871-docs-typecheck-typegen` · Worktree: `objectstack-issue-10871`
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus`
File surface: `apps/docs/package.json`, `apps/docs/tsconfig.json` (if needed), and whichever CI/turbo wiring the fix requires.

## Scope, and the judgement left to the implementer

The question is **not** "wire `types:check` into CI" reflexively — it is: **which of the two scripts is the real contract, and does the other survive?** Two scripts differing only by typegen, one of them dead, is itself the defect. Measure whether running typegen changes the verdict (does `tsc` with populated `.next/types` catch anything the bare run misses?) and let that decide:

- if typegen materially changes coverage ⇒ the wired one must be `types:check`, and `typecheck` should stop existing as a trap;
- if it does not ⇒ the honest fix may be deleting `types:check` and narrowing `include`, so the config stops promising coverage it does not have.

⛔ **Do not leave both.** ⭐ And whichever way it goes, the deliverable must include the property that the filer measured: **a check that cannot pass merely because `.next` happens to be populated.** State how your change makes the empty-`.next` case honest.

## Standing constraints

- ⛔ Governed, human-merge-only: `docs/adr/**`, `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`.
- ⛔ Never edit `content/docs/releases/**`. ⛔ Never `git stash` — `refs/stash` is shared by every worktree.
- ⚠️ **A pipe swallows the exit code.** Capture as `cmd > log 2>&1; ec=$?`.
- ⚠️ ⭐ **#10853: `pnpm --filter <name>` with a name that does not exist prints `No projects matched the filters` and EXITS 0.** Verify your filter matched — a sibling proved `@objectstack/docs` resolves by `pnpm --filter @objectstack/docs exec pwd`, which is the cheap check.
- ⚠️ **The shared checkout at `/home/user/objectstack` is STALE.** Measure against `origin/main` or your own worktree.
- ⚠️ `apps/docs` is `private: true` with `privatePackages.tag=false` ⇒ likely `skip-changeset`; decide from your real file list.
- ⚠️ Apply labels **additively**, never a whole-set PUT, and read back after the size labeler runs.
- ⚠️ `main` has `Console Pin Gate` red for a known unrelated cross-repo reason (#10856) — **non-blocking**, ⛔ not yours.

Report back to me; I review against GitHub and land it.

Property 'nonexistentParam' is missing in type '{ lang: string; }'`. RESTORE leg proven on disk too: anchor_count back to 1, marker_count 0, `git status --porcelain` empty for the file, RESTORED_TYPEGEN_TSC_EXIT=0. CARD'S REQUIRED PROOF (rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts first): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/docs typecheck` -> TYPECHECK_EXIT=0 in 4s, next_types_dir=yes next_env_now=yes; negative control on the same tree OLD_BARE_TSC_EXIT=0. Filter resolution verified per #10853: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/docs exec pwd` printed /home/user/objectstack-issue-10871/apps/docs. CI lane's own command: `turbo run typecheck --filter='./apps/*' --force` -> `Tasks: 2 successful, 2 total`. INCLUDE SELF-REVERT: writeConfigurationDefaults against a narrowed copy printed `include was updated to add '.next/dev/types/**/*.ts'`, DEV_GLOB_READDED_BY_NEXT=YES. GATES derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (no paths passed; it took 2 paths vs merge base 7d483e1e5, exit 0) and run at 8140f71b39, each quoting its own verdict line: check:override-consistency `✓ 8 published-manifest declaration(s) ... resolve to their override targets.`; check:test-source-alias `check-test-source-alias OK — 72 packages with tests scanned`; check:type-source-resolution `check-type-source-resolution OK — 76 packages with a tsconfig.json scanned`; check-changeset-fixed `✓ .changeset/config.json \"fixed\" group is in sync with 69 public workspace packages.`; check-osv-exemptions `✓ osv-scanner.toml holds zero OSV exemptions (the intended steady state).`; check:nul-bytes `check-nul-bytes: OK (scanned 6294 text file(s) ... no raw ASCII control bytes).`; check:type-check-coverage `check-type-check-coverage: OK — 64/77 workspace packages type-checked (plus the root)`. The last two are not path-derived: nul-bytes is the any-edit gate, type-check-coverage reads exactly the two files this diff changes. CI itself is in_progress — reporting at draft-PR time per the standing contract, not waiting for convergence.",
```json
  "open_questions": [],
  "out_of_scope_findings": [
    "filed as #10880: check:type-check-coverage has no invariant for a tsconfig `include` naming a GENERATED directory the package's typecheck script never generates — the class-closing guard for this card, deliberately kept out of the PR because it would edit the 3790-line required-context gate that #10756 is already dispatched against (same file, different invariant; needs sequencing, not parallel work)"
  ]
}
```

**Label read-back** (applied additively as the union with what the bots had already written, never a bare set): `documentation`, `dependencies`, `size/s`, `tooling`, `skip-changeset`. `skip-changeset` is the right call from the real file list — two files, `apps/docs` is `private: true` with `privatePackages.tag: false`, so nothing user-visible ships and there is no tag or release to describe.

PR #10879 is a **draft**, as dispatched. Diff is `apps/docs/package.json` (+1/-2) and `apps/docs/tsconfig.json` (+24/-0), 2 files.
